summary: Tested Phase Description/Notes feature end-to-end. Backend (9/9) passes: notes returned by POST/GET /projects/{id}/phases and PATCH /phases/{id}; empty description skipped; notification bell fires PhaseNote to non-actors; DELETE phase with notes returns 204. FRONTEND CRITICAL BUG: phase notes are NOT rendered in the UI even though the API returns them correctly, because ProjectDetailPage reads phases from GET /api/projects/{id} (project_out detail) which does NOT include the `notes` array. Only GET /api/projects/{id}/phases includes notes. Result: TC-PD-03/04/06 fail in UI — user never sees history under phase timeline.

critical.issue: project_out(detail=True) returns phases via phase_out() which omits `notes`. UI consumes this endpoint, so history never renders. Fix: include notes in phase_out when called from project_out detail path (or have frontend also fetch /projects/{id}/phases and merge, or switch PhaseTimeline data source).

ui_bugs.issue: phase-notes-{id} container never rendered because project.phases (from useProject → GET /projects/{id}) has no `notes` field. Verified in DOM: querySelector returns NOT FOUND right after creating a phase whose API response has notes=1.

integration_issues.flow: Add/Edit Phase with description → history render
integration_issues.issue: API stores + returns note correctly (verified), but ProjectDetailPage never receives the notes array from its data source. Toast shows 'Phase added', new phase appears, but no dated note card underneath.

issues: Missing aria-describedby on DialogContent (console warning) — minor a11y

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix data source for PhaseTimeline. Simplest fix — in /app/backend/app/crud/__init__.py::project_out (detail branch), replace `[phase_out(ph) for ph in p.phases]` with a variant that attaches notes per phase (query PhaseNote grouped by phase_id, same as phase_notes_map). Or make phase_out accept a notes_map argument. Alternatively, in ProjectDetailPage.jsx switch to a dedicated `usePhases(projectId)` hook that calls GET /projects/{id}/phases and pass those to <PhaseTimeline>. After fix, TC-PD-03/04/06 UI checks will pass (backend already good).

rca of the issue: GET /api/projects/{id} returns phases via crud.project_out(detail=True) which calls phase_out(ph) — a serializer that intentionally omits the `notes` field. The `notes` field is only appended in add_phase, update_phase, and list_phases (via phase_notes_map). Frontend PhaseTimeline is rendered from `project.phases` populated by useProject → GET /api/projects/{id}, so the notes array is undefined and the `(ph.notes || []).length > 0` guard in PhaseTimeline.jsx suppresses the whole `phase-notes-{id}` block. Reproduction: (1) login admin, (2) /admin/projects/1 → Phases tab, (3) Add Phase with description, (4) confirm API POST response has notes=[{...}], (5) inspect DOM — no [data-testid=phase-notes-{id}] element. Mitigation: attach notes in project_out detail (single DB pass via phase_notes_map(db, p.id)) OR fetch phases via GET /projects/{id}/phases in the detail page.
